detail.longDescription: Unpopular opinion: 90% of "being productive" is just closing 40 unused browser tabs and pretending you have everything under control. My brain: "Keep them open, you might need that article from 3 weeks ago." 🧠 Are you a tab hoarder or a tab minimalist? Be honest! 👇 # Productivity # WorkLife # TechHumor # Mindset # Mastodon # DailyLife # Focus
